verdict.rationale: L1 met: 15 tests assert invariants (min-image vs brute force, single-contact stress sign+normalisation, packing fraction, synthetic n=0/n=2 recovery, gate-refusal path) -- replayed green by the auditor. L2 met: a self-contained 825-line SLLOD/Lees-Edwards kernel with a real input->compute->output path; one filed point reproduces bit-exactly (tau*=11.187963375044525). L3 met at branch level: `elastic-limit-shear` is wired into src/tensordem/cli.py (+37 lines) and runs end-to-end via `python -m tensordem` (kappa=57.87, tau*=1.562, all gates pass at N=200) -- but the branch is NOT merged into main, so trunk still ships the round-1 kernel with no wiring. L4 NOT met: of the 4 registered referee legs only ['R3'] passes (1/4); R1 and R2 fail, R4 is WITHHELD. That single pass is a cross-over exponent in the dense-inertial regime (I=0.08-0.56, tau* still growing x54.9), it exists only after an energy gate loosened 3x after the runs (the shipped artifacts carry gates.all=0 under their own gate 0.1 and were never regenerated), the energy audit closes only to 19-25% of the shear work with an unidentified mechanism, the documented CLI repro command is a silent no-op, and the finite-size study is not run. Real kernel + tests + CLI wiring + a partially validated case = L3.
verdict.why_not_L4: The structural L4 tests (complete case, error analysis, reproducibility) are met on paper: a full kappa ladder + rate sweeps, a dt-convergence pair, an explicit per-leg error statement, and bit-exact reproducibility by the auditor. What is NOT met is the referee itself: 3 of the 4 registered legs are unmet, and the single passing leg collapses to zero gated points if the gate recorded inside the artifacts (0.1) is applied instead of the 0.30 that the committed code silently substitutes. An honest FAIL is a legitimate scientific result, but it cannot be booked as 'benchmark validated' while the case's own artifacts contradict the gated set they are supposed to support. Hence L3, not L4; nothing in this verdict disputes the physics numbers themselves, which reproduce exactly.
